notes.title: Patch 1.07 - BugFix
notes.notes:
Greetings Pengreens!

A Bug regarding a non-responsive truck on Level 9 was reported by some users and is fixed on this small update.
Some minor audio issues were also fixed along this patch.

If you find any problem, please, feel free to keep in touch.

Thanks for your compreension!
Studio SoulAres

notes.title: Patch 1.06 - BugFix
notes.notes:
There was a bug in the when it should Save your Game Data.The .sav files local files couldn't be created correctly.

This bug is fixed  now in version 1.06.
Now the game saves automatically everytime the player returns to level select screen.

If you find any problem, please, feel free to keep in touch.

Thanks for your compreension!
Studio SoulAres

notes.title: Patch 1.05 - BugFix
notes.notes:

We have some bugs that were crashing the game controls, when picking some itens on the floor.

If you all experience any kind of error, please enter in contact and we will fix it asap!

notes.title: Pengreens Update 1.04
notes.notes:
Greetings Pengreens!

We're happy to announce that the Load Game bug were fixed.
Some penguins had a problem were the game couldn't load your progress correctly when they started a new playing session.
This issue is already fixed.

If y'all have any problems with the game, feel free to keep in touch!

Best Regards,
Studio SoulAres

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - BugFix
notes.notes:

If the error persists, please, keep in contact and we will fix it asap!

Have a nice play,
